name: webflow-mcp
description: Webflow (builder tools): me, list_items, get_item, create_item, update_item, delete_item. Every tool

platform_mcp_webflow_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WEBFLOW_TOKEN
platform_mcp_webflow_token.description: Webflow site API token (Site settings > Apps & integrations > API access) or OAuth access token with CMS:read/CMS:write (and authorized_user:read for me).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v2/token/authorized_by: the user who authorized the token (id, email, name).

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: GET /v2/collections/{collection_id}/items?offset&limit (≤100)&name: staged CMS items of the collection (collection is required: a collection id). query filters by exact item name; url is the item slug.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: GET /v2/collections/{collection_id}/items/{item_id}: one staged item; content is its fieldData object.

tools.name: create_item
tools.description: POST /v2/collections/{collection_id}/items {fieldData: {name, slug, …}}: fields is the fieldData (slug is required by Webflow; rich-text fields take HTML), title sets name. The item is staged; publish it with the site/items publish endpoints. content is not sent (field slugs differ per collection).

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: PATCH /v2/collections/{collection_id}/items/{item_id} {fieldData}: updates the given fields of the staged item.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: DELETE /v2/collections/{collection_id}/items/{item_id}: deletes the staged item (a published copy stays live until unpublished).
